title: Monochromatic Portrait with Signature and Text
coreRelationships: The portrait dominates the composition, creating a strong focal point.
The dark background provides a stark contrast, emphasizing the subject's features.
The signature and text elements are secondary, positioned to not distract from the main portrait.
The overall monochromatic scheme unifies all elements, creating a cohesive and serious mood.
reuseFormula: Recreate a high-contrast, monochromatic portrait of a subject looking right, against a dark, textured background. Overlay a light-colored, flowing signature and small, clean sans-serif text in the lower right. Add a standard parental advisory label in the lower left.
